findings.description: interestIndex.currentIndex() is RAY (1e27) but mulWadDown divides by WAD (1e18), so the product stays RAY-scaled and the following division by a RAY entryIndex collapses the result to a bare integer.
findings.impact: Debt is understated by roughly 1e18; positions never appear undercollateralized.

findings.description: The debt is owed in debtToken but the WAD amount is converted with collateralTokens[0]'s decimals, so the scale factor is wrong whenever the two assets differ.
findings.impact: An 18-decimal collateral against a 6-decimal debt asset under-converts by 1e12.

findings.description: Squaring sqrtPriceX96 produces a Q128.192 value, but only one 96-bit shift is removed, leaving the price larger than the true value by 2^96.
findings.impact: Every collateral valuation is wrong by 2^96.

findings.description: borrowFee is an 18-decimal fraction (0.003e18) but is divided by BPS_DENOMINATOR (10_000) instead of WAD.
Raw balances of different collateral assets are summed directly, adding quantities in different units and different decimals.
findings.impact: The total is dimensionless nonsense; 8-decimal WBTC is added to 18-decimal WETH.
findings.recommendation: Normalize each balance with registry.toWad and price it before summing.
